page.layout: One column of running Latin text with an Arabic quotation in verse, set below a line of Latin. Page number at top right. A small reference mark in the right margin beside the second paragraph. Below the text: a signature "Tt" and an Arabic catchword at the bottom left.

main_text.p: tionibus. Hac enim ratione unico verbo, imo unica particula omnia Reformatorum effata & ego evertere possum, si dicam: Non.

Ex Maronitis vero, praeter ea, quæ habentur in Catechismo, plures de hac etiam materia scripserunt, inter quos tamen Gabriel Klahi vir doctissimus, & in omni litterarum genere eruditissimus, integrum edidit Opusculum, quo petulantia ora retundi facile poterunt, si Epistolæ limites hoc nobis permitterent. Sed alias, & opportuniori occasione, Deo sospitante.r
Melchitæ hoc de argumento fusè agunt in suo Catechismo, ubi inter cætera hæc subijcitur:
Adhortatio ad Confessionem, ligata oratione, ut facilius memoriae tradatur, & retineatur.

بغير الاعتراف لا عحد لك توبة. ولا
عو ذنب ولو قتلت شهيدا :
ولو صمت كل الدهر بالمسك والعيا .
واحفيت طي الركبتين مديدا :
ولو سجدت يدك فى الارض بالعطا .

page.notes: Arabic verse is set in a small, worn type; the letters inside words such as "عحد", "عو", "العيا" and "مديدا" are doubtful and not checked against a source, so they may contain errors. The Arabic line after "subijcitur" is partly illegible and was copied only as far as it could be read. The right-margin mark after "op-" could be a reference letter ("r") or a printer's sign; it is uncertain. The catchword "على" and signature "Tt" are placed as printed at the foot.
